Wakanda is a fictional, landlocked African country in the MCU, located near Lake Turkana and bordered by Ethiopia, South Sudan, Uganda, and Kenya. It is surrounded by mountains and jungles, and its capital combines advanced technology with traditional design. [wp-66902704-lore-p30] [wp-66902704-lore-p31]

For much of its history, Wakanda hid its advanced civilization from the outside world, presenting itself as a poor, modest nation. [wp-66902704-lore-p35] COVERAGE: full
